movies.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
movies.description: If you think about it long enough, anything can be supernatural – your toothbrush, a pair of sneakers, or your parents. That’s what makes A TALE OF TWO SISTERS so terrifying. Sisters Soo-mi and Soo-yeon arrive at their father’s country home to spend some quality time with their new stepmother. But there’s trouble in paradise. For proof, check out the severed hands that live in a kitchen cabinet. The first Korean horror movie to be distributed in America, A TALE OF TWO SISTERS is a beautiful hallucinogen. It’s quiet, violent, and visually stunning, feeling like a Korean version of THE SHINING as filtered through the adolescent pre-angst of a Judy Blume novel if Judy Blume was secretly a demon. You’ll never see another haunted house movie like this one – and you’ll never forget it. (Joseph A. Ziemba)

movies.title: Area Coded: American Regionalism In Film
movies.description: Programmed by Jessica Green The United States has spent roughly 120 of its 250 years creating the moving-image mythology of itself. To travel through American cinema is to travel through America itself—not as one country with one identity, but as a collection of distinct places, histories, cultures, and dreams constructed through expansion, migration, displacement, genocide, enslavement, immigration, industrialization, and urbanization. Our nation's regional films get beneath the mythology: the communities that shape the nation, the contradictions that define it, and the local cultures that ultimately become global. The Gulf Coast, West Texas, the Deep South, Rocky Mountains, New England, the Rust Belt, and the Pacific Northwest produce particular ways of living and seeing the world. The films in this series explore the very specific American places that produce culture that the rest of the world now recognizes as American.

movies.title: Bitterroot
movies.description: In western Montana, recently divorced Lue lives with his mother and keeps to a steady, quiet routine: his maintenance job, working his family stand at the farmers market, fly fishing on the river, and midnight outings for karaoke at the local bar. He lives with his widowed mother, Song, whose efforts to find him another wife are unwelcome and increasingly difficult to avoid. Song worries that she can’t get through to him, and seeks guidance from the ancestors. The order that Lue clings to begins to crumble when he is suddenly laid off. He hides the truth from Song and scrambles to find work, but she senses something is wrong. She consults her shaman for help, but Lue only pulls further away. Soon Lue discovers that the spirit world may still have influence over his life—and he must finally face the buried pain that destroyed his marriage.

movies.title: Brigham City
movies.description: In Richard Dutcher’s portrait of Mormon life, an idyllic Utah town faces its first murder, and the possibility that the killer is one of its own. In addition to directing, Dutcher stars as Wes Clayton, the town sheriff and an LDS bishop, whose investigation forces him to navigate the uneasy intersection of faith, community, and justice. With its picturesque small-town setting and deliberately restrained performances, the film gradually turns the familiar rhythms of community life into a tense, morally charged mystery. Brigham City serves as an intriguing moment in the filmography of Dutcher, who was deemed the “The Godfather of Mormon Cinema” by Deseret News before leaving the church in 2007.

movies.title: Cameron Winter At Carnegie Hall
movies.description: Cameron Winter, in December 2025, after a months-long sold-out tour with his band Geese, returned to New York to play a single show at Carnegie Hall. This is the movie. Directed and shot on 35mm and 16mm by Oscar-winning filmmaker Paul Thomas Anderson ( One Battle After Another ), the crew includes filmmaker and actor Benny Safdie ( The Smashing Machine ) and music producer Ariel Rechtshaid (Grammy winner for albums with Vampire Weekend and Adele). GQ praised Cameron Winter’s show at Carnegie Hall as “staggeringly good,” and Nick Cave said he has a "a glorious, emotive voice with brilliant, blistering words, a racked and wondrous thing.” Winter’s solo album Heavy Metal was named one of the best of the year by Pitchfork , Rolling Stone , Paste and Mojo and Geese’s last record Getting Killed was named the best album of 2025 by The New Yorker , NME , and Stereogum .

movies.title: Castration Movie Iii + Drinking And Driving
movies.description: Born out of an understanding of the role that accessibility plays in shaping cultural histories, Muscle Distribution is dedicated to complicating and expanding the canon by shining a light on works that either never received their proper due or that have unjustly faded into obscurity, and championing uncompromising new works by some of today’s most exciting underground filmmakers. In that spirit, BAM is proud to highlight two films: Louise Weard’s Castration Movie Chapter iii. Junior Ghosts—Premorphic Drift ; a fragmentary passage + Avalon Fast’s Drinking and Driving . Emblems of Muscle’s commitment to scrappy, misfit films that don’t fit into any particular box, Weard’s postmodern epic meditates on a transphobic rift, and Fast’s smalltown saga steeps in summertime malaise.

movies.title: Clarissa
movies.description: In this tender, quietly virtuosic adaptation of Mrs. Dalloway , twin filmmakers Arie and Chuko Esiri transport Virginia Woolf’s great 1925 novel to contemporary Nigeria, where the affluent Clarissa (Oscar nominee Sophie Okonedo, in a richly contemplative performance) is getting her opulent home ready for an elaborate party. These preparations send Clarissa into reverie over her past and the unresolved loves of her youth, while, as in Woolf’s book, the film expands to follow the parallel story of Septimus (Fortune Nwafor), a soldier suffering from PTSD, in this case after his experiences fighting the country’s Boko Haram jihadist insurgency. Affirming the promise of their dazzling 2020 debut Eyimofe ( This Is My Desire ) (New Directors/New Films 2021), the Esiri brothers demonstrate their wizardry for intricate, overlapping narratives, retaining the spiritual essence of Woolf’s themes—memory and time, modernity and progress, class and privilege—while placing them in an enriching, new cultural context. The outstanding ensemble cast also includes David Oyelowo, India Amarteifio, Toheeb Jimoh, Nikki Amuka-Bird, Jude Akuwudike, and Ayo Edebiri. Clarissa had its world premiere at the 2026 Cannes Directors’ Fortnight. A NEON release.

movies.title: Club Kid
movies.cast: Jordan Firstman, Cara Delvingne, Diego Calva, Kirby Howell-Baptiste, Reggie Absolom, Colleen Camp
movies.description: Washed-up thirtysomething New York scenester Peter (Jordan Firstman), awakening from a decade-long hangover, receives an unexpected visitor: the 10-year-old British son (Reggie Absolom) he never knew he had. The result of a lone, long-forgotten sexual encounter with a woman, the kid is in desperate need of care after his mother’s death, and though Peter has never put his heart into anything other than promoting massive parties, the experience of becoming an insta-dad prompts a reconsideration of his hedonistic, drug-fueled party boy lifestyle. Swerving from irreverent satire to genuine pathos, this wildly funny and remarkably assured feature debut from writer-director-actor Firstman is an unusual and satisfying take on the challenges and pleasures of queer millennial living, and a loving reminder that it’s never too late to come of age. An A24 release.

movies.title: Daughters of Darkness
movies.description: Of the several amazing things that have ever come out of Europe, right at the top of the list is the Lesbian Vampire movie. And there is no more superlative example of that ecstatic, erotic, licentiously macabre territory than Belgian weirdo Harry Kumel's hyper-stylized psychological high Gothic heart-piercer DAUGHTERS OF DARKNESS. The world's worst newlywed couple arrive at an enormous, abandoned hotel in the middle of winter but are soon joined by a mysterious Countess (played the impossibly elegant Delphine Seyrig) and her beautiful young secretary, who seem to have designs on the tortured young bride. Strange gets stranger as desire and terror intertwine and the couple descend into a world of sadism, obsession, sex, death, and of course — lesbian vampires! Saturated with powerful primary colors and surreal and sultry dialogue, DAUGHTERS OF DARKNESS also features possibly THE greatest horror film score of all time. Eroticized power, decaying grandeur, abstract and ceremonious evil...(Tommy Swenson).

Presented in Japanese with English subtitles
The world-famous classic Alice in Wonderland receives its first Japanese theatrical animated adaptation! 
Rise Azumino is a university student who feels lost in her life. One day, guided by an invitation letter left behind by her late grandmother, she enters “Wonderland”. She meets a girl named Alice there and they travel together. The Queen of Hearts, the Mad Hatter, Cheshire Cat…the residents of Wonderland appear before Rise one after another and crazy commotion ensues! What kind of future will Rise choose in this crazy adventure with Alice?

movies.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
movies.description:
Celebrate Doctor Who Day with an exclusive big-screen event marking 20 years of the Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler.
For the first time ever in cinemas, the acclaimed two-part adventure The Impossible Planet and The Satan Pit has been specially re-edited into a single movie-length presentation, created exclusively for theatrical audiences. Join the Doctor (David Tennant) and Rose (Billie Piper) as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.
This special Doctor Who Day screening also includes exclusive bonus material, featuring previously unseen content and a brand-new interview with a special guest, reflecting on the making of one of the most celebrated stories of the modern era – from encounters with the Ood to facing the terrifying Beast, alongside behind-the-scenes memories from the set.

movies.title: Dolly Double Feature: 9 To 5
movies.description: Box-office smash 9 to 5 , featuring Dolly Parton’s Oscar-nominated title song, is one of the most hilarious comedies ever made—starring Parton alongside Jane Fonda, Lily Tomlin, and Dabney Coleman. Stuck in a dead-end job under a boss that she trained, Violet Newstead (Lily Tomlin) is at her wit’s end. But when the boss’s good-natured secretary (Dolly Parton) and new hire (Jane Fonda) decide that they’ve had enough, too, their revenge fantasy becomes comedic reality in a scheme that spins wildly out of control. This film is part of a DOLLY DOUBLE feature program with Steel Magnolias (1989) playing at BAM on Saturday, October 17.

movies.title: Dolly Double Feature: Steel Magnolias
movies.description: Parton earned some of her best reviews as Truvy, owner of the beauty salon at the heart of Steel Magnolias . Starring alongside an award-winning ensemble—Sally Field, Shirley MacLaine, Daryl Hannah, Olympia Dukakis, and Julia Roberts—the bosom buddies navigate life, love, and loss in small-town Louisiana. Among Truvy’s clients is Shelby Eatenton (Julia Roberts), newly married and joyfully pregnant, though her diabetes could make childbirth life-threatening. Terrified of losing her only daughter, M’Lynn Eatenton (Sally Field) turns to her four closest friends for strength as she faces her deepest fear. This film is part of a Dolly Double feature program with 9 to 5 (1980) playing at BAM on Saturday, October 17. Screening in 35mm.

movies.title: Double Freedom
movies.description: Twenty-five years after his debut, La Libertad (NYFF39), Argentinean director Lisandro Alonso returns to and expands upon that remarkable first feature with an unexpected sequel of sorts. Double Freedom is a contemplative, emotionally gratifying extrapolation of Alonso’s recurring themes, again following charismatic everyman Misael (Misael Saavedra), a taciturn woodcutter and man of the land who lives in Argentina’s lowland pampas region. Alonso closely observes Misael’s routine with loving attention and care, becalmed long takes emphasizing the beauty and exertion of his labor. Yet Alonso has a curveball for Misael and for us: his mentally unstable sister (Catalina Saavedra, star of the beloved dark comedy The Maid ) has been released from a care facility that has lost its government funding, and he must take her in. In enhancing the split between documentary and fiction—and between nonprofessional performer and actor—Alonso has created a drama about the limits of personal freedom that feels both elegantly crafted and weighted by lived experience.

movies.title: Elephants In The Fog
movies.description: Deep in the forests of rural Nepal, Pirati leads a household of Kinnar women, an ancient third-gender community revered and feared for their perceived spiritual power. As wild elephants descend on the village at night, the villagers take turns patrolling the darkness to protect their crops and homes. Meanwhile, Pirati dreams of escaping this life with the mustachioed Drum Master she loves, beyond the sacred vows that bind her. When one of her daughters disappears during a patrol and the police fail to investigate, Pirati sets out to find answers herself. As the mystery unravels, stirring up dangerous tensions within the family, Pirati is forced to choose between the love she longs for and responsibility for her beloved community. Director Abinash Bikram Shah was the recipient of the Un Certain Regard Jury Prize at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival.

Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

movies.title: Everest: The Other Side
movies.cast: Hilaree Nelson, Jim Morrison
movies.description: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport: Everest's north face.

movies.title: Eve’S Bayou
movies.description: Kasi Lemmons made a splash with one of the most distinctive directorial debuts of the 1990s, a richly atmospheric, Southern Gothic stew of sex, lies, and voodoo in which a young girl witnesses secrets and deceptions tearing her wealthy Louisiana family apart. A primordial American blend of Creole folklore, magic, and mysticism, Eve’s Bayou provides a scintillating showcase for a powerhouse ensemble of Black actresses.

movies.cast: Bruce Campbell, Sarah Berry, Dan Hicks

movies.title: Eyes Of Fire
movies.description: Before The Witch , there was Eyes of Fire . In this seminal 1980s folk horror gem, a rogue 18th century preacher and his followers attempt to establish a settlement beyond the western frontier. But when they encounter a not-so-enchanted forest filled with evil spirits, the group exchanges happiness for apocalyptic madness. Newly restored from the original camera negative, Eyes of Fire is a dreamlike hallucination that combines arthouse surrealism, gonzo creature effects, and ambitious symbolism to build a truly haunting experience. Imagine Werner Herzog directing an A24 film in 1983 and you’re halfway there.

movies.title: Fatherland
movies.director: Paweł Pawlikowski Starring Hanns Zischler And Sandra Hüller
movies.description: Academy Award–nominated director Paweł Pawlikowski ( Cold War , NYFF56) specializes in narratively economical yet emotionally and philosophically expansive historical drama, and his latest film, which earned him a Best Director prize at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival, might be his most potent and provocative yet. Set in the aftermath of World War II, Fatherland follows the Nobel Prize–winning novelist Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika Mann (Sandra Hüller) on a fictionalized 1949 road trip across a torn Germany that’s at once reeling from the destruction of battle and in profound denial about its evils and culpability. As they move from the East to the occupied West, Pawlikowski uses Thomas and Erika’s fraught interpersonal dynamics and own familial tragedies to reflect upon a country facing an ever-evolving moral urgency. Cinematographer Łukasz Żal’s beautifully stark black-and-white frames and Hüller and Zischler’s expertly restrained performances combine to evoke a Europe gradually awakening to a new historical reckoning. A MUBI release.

movies.title: Fatherland
movies.description: At the height of the Cold War, the writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika—an actress, writer, and rally driver—embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a divided Germany in ruins, traveling from the Allied-occupied city of Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

movies.title: Faust (1926)
movies.description: Mobilizing the full resources of the Ufa Studios, F.W. Murnau (Nosferatu, Sunrise) orchestrated a colossal adaptation of Goethe's FAUST that ranks alongside Fritz Lang's Metropolis as the greatest achievement of the German silent cinema.Gösta Ekman stars as the titular alchemist who, struggling with his faith amidst a devastating plague, is offered the power to cure and the gift of youth...in exchange for his soul. As the diabolical Mephisto, Emil Jannings (The Last Laugh) delivers a performance of operatic scale and intensity, by turns charming, comical, and horrific.This special Kino edition contains the Friedrich Wilhelm Murnau Foundation’s meticulous restoration of the original German version of the film (with unique hand-painted intertitles), as well as a lengthier alternate cut prepared by the Ufa Studios in 1930.

movies.title: Fireball 500

movies.title: Fresh Meat
movies.description: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going. Dead Meat presents thirteen nightmares— and something hungry for more.

movies.title: Giant
movies.description: Elizabeth Taylor, James Dean, and Rock Hudson star in a sweeping saga of jealousy, racism, and the clash of cultures set in the vast Texas oilfields. Wealthy rancher Bick Benedict (Hudson) and dirt-poor cowboy Jett Rink (Dean) both woo Leslie Lynnton (Taylor), a beautiful young woman from Maryland who is new to Texas. She marries Benedict, but is shocked by the racial bigotry of the White Texans against the local people of Mexican descent. Rink discovers oil on a small plot of land, and while he uses his vast, new wealth to buy all the land surrounding the Benedict ranch, the Benedicts’ disagreement over prejudice fuels conflict that runs across generations.

movies.title: Ginger Snaps
movies.cast: Emily Perkins, Katharine Isabelle. Kris Lemche, Mimi Rogers
movies.description: One of the dumbest prejudices perpetuated by the world is that menstrual cycles turn women into monsters. That conceit is what makes GINGER SNAPS so incredible. The Fitzgerald sisters are death-obsessed high school goths who create ultra-violent art projects while battling the popular kids. But everything changes when someone’s period – and a werewolf – enters the picture. Combining the revisionist energy of AN AMERICAN WEREWOLF IN LONDON, the body-horror of SHIVERS, and the black humor of HAROLD AND MAUDE, GINGER SNAPS is unpredictable and unbelievably fun. It’s also a takedown of gender bias in the form of a werewolf movie.

movies.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
movies.cast: Minami Hamabe, Masami Nagasawa, Ryûnosuke Kamiki, Jun Kunimura, Sakura Andô, Yuki Yamada
movies.description:
Presented in Japanese with English subtitles
War reduced Japan to zero. Godzilla plunged it into minus. Now the math gets even more terrifying. Takashi Yamazaki returns to direct, write, and oversee the visual effects for this epic follow-up to GODZILLA MINUS ONE, his Oscar-winning reinvention of Toho’s iconic monster. Set in 1949, two years after the events of the previous film, GODZILLA MINUS ZERO follows Japan’s hard-fought recovery as a new catastrophe threatens to erase it all. With returning stars Ryunosuke Kamiki and Minami Hamabe, bigger monster mayhem, and spectacular effects built for a huge screen, this is the latest chapter in a storied franchise that began in 1954. See the King of the Monsters at its most colossal, on the big screen.

movies.title: Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla
movies.description: Godzilla’s evil twin Mechagodzilla first reared its head in this Jun Fukuda–directed film. A robot designed by aliens to conquer Earth, the enduringly popular villain has since been resurrected by Toho Studios several times. With the help of earnest direction, spectacular pyrotechnics, and guest appearances by veteran genre actors, this film recaptures the feel of the '60s Godzilla movies. (Janus)

movies.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
movies.description: Weapons testing unleashes mayhem on the undersea kingdom of Seatopia, causing a series of environmental disasters that nearly wipe out Rokuro, the schoolboy protagonist at the center of this film. To exact revenge, Seatopia unleashes Megalon, a gigantic beetle with the ability to fire ray beams and napalm bombs. Meanwhile, Rokuro’s brother creates Jet Jaguar, a flying robot with a built-in moral compass. The inevitable matchup of Godzilla and Jet Jaguar versus Megalon and Gigan decides the world’s fate. (Janus)

movies.title: Grey Gardens
movies.cast: Big Edie, Little Edie
movies.description: Meet Big and Little Edie Beale: mother and daughter, high-society dropouts, and reclusive cousins of Jackie Onassis. The two manage to thrive together amid the decay and disorder of their East Hampton, New York, mansion, making for an eerily ramshackle echo of the American Camelot. An impossibly intimate portrait, this 1976 documentary by Albert and David Maysles, codirected by Ellen Hovde and Muffie Meyer, quickly became a cult classic and established Little Edie as a fashion icon and philosopher queen.

movies.title: Halloween (1978)
movies.cast: Jamie Lee Curtis, Donald Pleasence
movies.description:
Preceded by animated short, SEASON'S GREETINGS, by Michael Dougherty
In 1978, legendary New Yorker film critic Pauline Kael reviewed John Carpenter's HALLOWEEN. She didn’t like it.
"HALLOWEEN has a pitiful, amateurish script (by Carpenter and his producer, Debra Hill). An escaped lunatic wielding a kitchen knife stalks people in a small Midwestern town (Haddonfield, Illinois), and that's about it. Maybe when a horror film is stripped of everything but dumb scariness – when it isn't ashamed to revive the stalest device of the genre (the escaped lunatic) – it satisfies part of the audience in a more basic, childish way than sophisticated horror pictures do."
Eternal respect to Ms. Kael, but what she disdained more than 40 years ago are the very elements that have made this film endure for over four decades.
HALLOWEEN might not have resembled the “sophisticated” horror films of the 1970s, but the simplicity of the film’s story and production values allowed Carpenter to focus on staying one step ahead of the audience. From Dean Cundey's flowing, blue-hued photography to Carpenter's minimalist score to the blank, ominous mask of Michael Myers, nothing in this moody, terrifying film is misplaced.
Just as BLAZING SADDLES, DIE HARD, and THE MATRIX reinvigorated their genres by satisfying in “basic, childish ways,” Carpenter created a pitch-perfect prototype in HALLOWEEN that changed an entire genre forever.

movies.title: Hellbound: Hellraiser II
movies.description: We have such sights to show you...again. Easily the greatest NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET sequel that isn’t a NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET sequel, HELLBOUND: HELLRAISER II further explores the hallucinogenic mind-war between Kirsty (Ashley Laurence), Pinhead (Doug Bradley), and his legion of hellspawned Ceno-bites. Produced by series creator Clive Barker and jam-packed with stunning practical effects, gothic visions, and grotesque body horror, HELLBOUND remains one of the most imaginative horror films of the 1980s.

movies.title: House of 1000 Corpses
movies.description:
The directorial debut from musician-turned-writer/director Rob Zombie suffered its own Hell making its way to theaters (the film was shot in 2000 and purchased by Universal only to be shelved and repurchased by Zombie who then resold it to Lionsgate who finally gave it a proper theatrical release in 2003), but eventually found its audience of devoted Gore Geeks.
Starring genre heroes Sid Haig, Bill Moseley, and Karen Black, the film is the classic tale of the wrong people in the wrong backwoods inbred place. October 30, 1977. Two couples on a road trip researching offbeat roadside attractions meet Captain Spaulding – the owner of the Museum of Monsters & Madmen – who tells them of a local legend, Dr. Satan. As you can imagine, things get sick, twisted, and bloody from here. If you think your family has weird Halloween traditions, wait till you get ahold of The Fireflys.

movies.description: An enduring, singular masterpiece of cinema starring Academy Award®-winner Vanessa Redgrave and Oliver Reed, KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is a prescient epic of obsession and corruption, and a defining work of art from seminal filmmaker Ken Russell. Assembled from the original camera negative, this new 4K restoration presents Ken Russell’s definitive vision of THE DEVILS by referencing the edit he privately constructed in 2004. KEN RUSSELL’S THE DEVILS is the uncut and unfiltered theatrical experience that Russell always envisioned – and the first time, the film will be presented restored and in 4K.

movies.description:
Presented in Spanish with English subtitles
"A rousing maximalist slice of magic" – A.V. Club
From Cannes-winning directors Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi – popularly known as Los Javis – LA BOLA NEGRA follows three generations of men across pivotal moments in Spanish history, bound by pain, desire, and love. Carlos (Milo Quifes) longs to belong in a fractured Spain. Sebastián (Guitarricadelafuente) finds connection across enemy lines. And Alberto (Carlos González) uncovers a long-buried family secret – one that finally gives voice to truths the past tried to erase.

movies.title: La Gradiva
movies.description: A group of French high school students travel to Pompeii on a class trip to discover its ruins and the bodies petrified by Vesuvius in 79 CE. In this ghost town, they are suddenly overcome by an intense sensation and drawn into a dizzying descent. One by one, James, Toni, Suzanne, and their Latin teacher, Mme Mercier, are swept up in desire and anger—until they surrender to them completely. Marine Atlan’s feature directorial debut La Gradiva is an affecting and evocative coming-of-age travel drama, where the force of youth meets a world frozen in time.

movies.title: Littermates
movies.description:
At Chester’s cottage, good behavior earns karaoke. Getting answers is a little more complicated.
After a mysterious apocalyptic(ish) attack leaves them bloodied, disoriented, and unable to speak, Liam (Joey Bader) and Mel (Kaylee McGregor) take refuge in the English countryside. Their oddball host, Chester (Oliver Woolf), feeds them, helps them recover, and introduces a system of rewards: behave yourself, earn “nifties,” cash them in for hot-tub time and dance parties.
Beyond the cottage, things are less nifty. But within it, a makeshift family is taking shape. While Liam embraces their new life, Mel grows increasingly curious about the world Chester insists is too dangerous to enter…
In their feature debut, directors Scott Tinkham and Michael Woloson mix deadpan comedy, sibling rivalry, and creeping unease in a coming-of-age story about people who have to grow up all over again. Winner of the Special Jury Prize at the 2026 Manchester Film Festival and the Narrative Feature Audience Award at Dances With Films LA 2026, this has the sort of sensibilities that fans of Yorgos Lanthimos and Ben Wheatley will adore… and it’s a natural fit as an Alamo Exclusive.

movies.title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
movies.description:
Q: Are we not men? A: WE ARE MANOS! 
Mike (Harold P. Warren) and Maggie (Diane Mahree) are on a road trip with their daughter and family dog. But they take a wrong turn and wind up at a lodge inhabited by a polygamous pagan cult! The family finds themselves in the middle of a power struggle between caretaker Torgo (John Reynolds), cult leader The Master (Tom Neyman), and two warring factions of the Master’s wives. The sole directorial effort of Texas fertilizer salesman Warren, MANOS: THE HANDS OF FATE is an absurdist masterpiece. Prepare to exit the planet.

movies.title: Masc
movies.description: Robin is a young man caught between multiple identities—autistic, biracial, queer, and unsure of what kind of man he wants to be. This dilemma leads to an intimate, at times funny, journey of self-discovery and missteps over the course of a critical year. As Robin tries on different roles and drifts from job to job, he reshapes his appearance and mannerisms to fit in. But will revealing what he’s most desperate to hide finally open the door to belonging? This screening will be followed by a Q&A.

movies.title: Move Ya Body: The Birth Of House
movies.description: From the South Side of Chicago to dance floors around the world, Elegance Bratton traces the underground roots of one of modern music’s most enduring genres. At the center is Vince Lawrence, a teenager who witnessed the infamous 1979 Disco Demolition Night and went on to help create what is widely considered the first house record. Blending archival footage, cinematic reenactments, and interviews with pioneering DJs, producers, and artists, Bratton captures the sweat, exuberance, and radical freedom of the Chicago club scene. A celebration of the Black and queer communities who shaped house music, the film connects the genre’s history to the transformative power of the dance floor.

movies.title: Mystery Transmission
movies.description: Imagine that a local cable station was invaded by otherdimensional creatures at the stroke of midnight. That's Video Vortex. Each month, this series presents a mystery transmission that's culled from the outer limits of home video history – from essential underground films to surreal docs, from tokusatsu battle-parties to outsider experiments. So warm up the cathode tubes, dim the lights, and let your senses intermingle with the glow.

movies.title: Naza
movies.description: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them. An urgent new documentary from two of the filmmakers of No Other Land . Director’s Statement: We made this film out of a sense of obligation to use our position as Israeli filmmakers and journalists to examine the systems behind the mass killing of Palestinian civilians for which our country is responsible. While filming members of Israel’s military on rooftops at night in Tel Aviv over the past three years, we found ourselves asking the very questions that were asked by our grandparents’ generation and throughout the 20th century: how does one group of people allow the total dehumanization of another? What do the inner workings of such a system look like? Many of the revelations in the film were published almost immediately as we learned of them, in the months following the October 7th attacks, by The Guardian (one of Naza ’s producers), in collaboration with reporting partners +972 Magazine and Local Call . The film lets us explore something deeper than we could in our investigative journalism alone: not only the words being said but also those that are not said, the silence. It is up to all of us to break that silence. —Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor

movies.title: New Negress Film Society Presents Black Women'S Film Conference 2026
movies.description: New Negress Film Society is a collective of Black women and non-binary filmmakers creating community, spaces, and films that reimagine cultural production beyond the traditions that have exploited our communities. Since 2019, the Black Women’s Film Conference has convened hundreds of filmmakers from around the world to showcase boundary-breaking work, discuss their craft, and exchange filmmaking strategies as both celebration and survival. This one-day gathering explores Black cinema at the intersections of history, film theory, filmmaking, and political action. Conversations and films featuring: Aicha Cherif, Joie Lee, Shirikiana Aina Gerima, Tchaiko Omawale, Akosua Adoma Owusu, Yace Sula, and Johanné Gómez Terrero. Still by Joie Lee from “Mother Hunger” Donate to the New Negress Film Society here: https://www.paypal.com/ncp/payment/MAZJMXNZRVNUU Tickets do not guarantee entry, admission is on a first come first serve basis.

movies.title: Nitrate Kisses
movies.description: Barbara Hammer’s pioneering first feature weaves together a liberating portrait of queer sexuality through a dizzying mix of archival and original footage: interviews, sexual imagery, and excerpts of documentary and narrative films from the 1930s, including the first gay film from the U.S., James Sibley Watson and Melville Webber’s Lot in Sodom (1933). Hammer’s editing juxtaposes contrasting images and sounds and brings past and present into an intimate and unexpected dialogue. With sections that explore, among other matters, the sexuality of American author Willa Cather and the status of lesbians in the Third Reich, Hammer’s film boldly pulls back the curtain on the queer experience. A Strand Releasing release. Restored by BB Optics (Mackenzie Lukenbill, Restoration Technician). Supported by Frameline and The Estate of Barbara Hammer. Restoration overseen by Brydie O’Connor.

movies.cast: Jessica Chastain, Jay Duplass, Arabella Olivia Clark, Dichen Lachman, Arian Moayed, Karen Allen
movies.description: Jessica Chastain plays both sides of motherhood in this unsettling supernatural thriller, as a loving mom and the terrifying presence that begins haunting her daughter’s home. Jay Duplass and Dichen Lachman co-star in a nightmare where the simple words “there’s someone in the house” take on a whole new meaning. And if a ball pit doesn’t already make you nervous, this movie may have some ideas for you. See it with friends, or bring your mom and have plenty to talk about on the way home.

movies.title: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back to the Beginning
movies.description:
OZZY & BLACK SABBATH: BACK TO THE BEGINNING documents a landmark moment in music history: Ozzy Osbourne’s historic final farewell performance for his fans at Villa Park stadium in his Birmingham hometown, captured just 17 days before his untimely passing. The film highlights the historic day with performances from Ozzy, Black Sabbath, and some of the most influential names in rock, along with personal reflections from the superstar musicians they inspired and a behind-the-scenes look at the day itself.
This is an historic and intimate farewell to Ozzy and the band that changed music forever.

movies.title: Paper Tiger
movies.cast: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson, Miles Teller

movies.title: Paper Tiger In 35Mm
movies.cast: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson, Miles Teller
movies.description: In James Gray’s deeply felt and intense crime thriller, set in 1986 New York, a naïve engineer, Irwin (Miles Teller) accepts a seemingly lucrative business proposition from his brother, Gary (Adam Driver), a former cop. But when Irwin witnesses something he wasn’t meant to see at the Gowanus Canal, the brothers find themselves pulled into a dangerous confrontation with the newly emerging Russian mafia. As the threat of violence escalates, Irwin’s wife Hester (Scarlett Johansson) sounds the alarm, Irwin desperately tries to protect his family, and Gary is forced to make an impossible choice to save those he loves.

movies.title: Paydirt
movies.description: In Penny Allen’s sun-dappled Pacific Northwest thriller, a struggling Oregon vintner couple turns to an unlikely cash crop: marijuana. But when a wave of robberies threatens their peaceful, countercultural existence, their rural idyll gives way to a strange and suspenseful battle over land, livelihood, and survival. Starring Eric Silverstein and Lola Desmond, Paydirt unfolds with a laid-back, laconic rhythm that gradually gives way to tension, blending slice-of-life realism with more blood-pumping fare.

movies.title: Pearl
movies.description:
The allure of stardom on the big screen proves to be a road to some very dark places for Mia Goth’s titular PEARL in this stylish and gruesome prequel to Ti West’s X. With her husband away at war, Pearl finds herself dreaming of a way to escape from her boring life on the farm. She sees the silver screen as her way to find stardom and the love she so desperately needs, but her overbearing mother and her own dark impulses might hold her back from the fame she craves.
PEARL proves to be a delightfully perverse study on a standout character from writer/director Ti West’s tribute to ‘70s grindhouse, X. Its vibrant, candy-coated veneer plays wonderfully against the depraved desires of the main character bubbling just below the surface. Co-writer/star Mia Goth gives another deliciously unhinged performance as Pearl, a not-quite-innocent farm girl looking for love in all the wrong places. As much a love letter to the Golden Age of Hollywood as it is a demented look at the darkness bubbling just below the surface of rural America, PEARL is colorful, unnerving, and twisted in all the right ways.

movies.title: Playback: The Brooklyn Watch Party
movies.description: BAM proudly joins forces with two iconic Brooklynites—filmmaker Spike Lee and Clara Wu Tsai, owner of the New York Liberty and the Brooklyn Nets—to present Playback: The Brooklyn Watch Party , a two-day celebration of the artists, storytellers, and communities that have made Brooklyn one of the most culturally influential places in the world. Created by filmmaker and producer Nicholas Ma ( Won’t You Be My Neighbor? , Unfinished Business ) and special guest curators, this inaugural festival includes screenings of repertory films, pop-up activations, a free street fair, and so much more—head to playbackbk.com and sign up to receive updates. Bios Spike Lee Spike Lee is a visionary filmmaker whose iconic body of work has defined cinema and television for over three decades, and an Oscar winner for Best Adapted Screenplay ( BlacKkKlansman ) and recipient of an Honorary Oscar for lifetime achievement. Lee’s acclaimed filmography includes classics such as Do the Right Thing, Malcolm X , and She’s Gotta Have It , alongside the landmark documentary When the Levees Broke . He operates 40 Acres and a Mule Filmworks in Brooklyn, New York. Clara Wu Tsai Clara Wu Tsai is a businesswoman and philanthropist. She is Governor and Owner of the New York Liberty and Owner of the Brooklyn Nets. Wu Tsai pursues philanthropic investments across the arts, science, and social justice spaces. She was an executive producer of Into the Okavango , Blue Bayou , Unfinished Business , the 2026 Sundance Special Jury winner Bedford Park , and Bucking Fastard , directed by Werner Herzog. Nicholas Ma Nicholas Ma is the President of Ernest Lyford LLC and an award-winning director, writer, speaker, and producer based in Brooklyn. He produced the acclaimed documentary Won’t You Be My Neighbor? , about the life of Fred Rogers, and Unfinished Business on the WNBA. Most recently, he directed Leap of Faith and Mabel . His brainchild, American Revival, a “traveling festival of hope,” has toured in seven cities across the US, selling out each show. Ahmir “Questlove" Thompson Ahmir “Questlove" Thompson is a six-time Grammy winner, Academy Award-winning and Emmy-nominated filmmaker, New York Times bestselling author, DJ, and cultural polymath. He’s the co-founder of Philadelphia’s influential hip hop group The Roots, and the Musical Director for The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon . He has also served in musical director positions for everyone from D'Angelo and Jay-Z to the 2024 Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. In 2025, Questlove was honored with the Peabody Trailblazer Award in recognition of his cultural impact and innovative storytelling. He was also named one of “The 100 Most Influential People of 2022” by Time Magazine . Most recently, Questlove directed the acclaimed documentary Earth, Wind & Fire (To Be Celestial vs. That's the Weight of the World) , which HBO premiered in 2026 under the banner of Two One Five Entertainment, the production company he launched with legendary Roots co-founder Black Thought. Bryan Stevenson Bryan Stevenson is a lawyer, social justice advocate, and founder and executive director of the Equal Justice Initiative, where he has spent decades representing death row prisoners, the wrongly convicted, and children sentenced as adults. Stevenson has argued and won multiple cases at the US Supreme Court. He also led the creation of the Legacy Sites in Montgomery, AL. He is the author of the New York Times bestseller Just Mercy , which was named by Time Magazine as one of the 10 Best Books of Nonfiction for 2014 and was adapted as a major motion picture. John Turturro John Turturro is a New York-raised actor, writer, and director with one of the most distinctive careers in film, television, and theater spanning over four decades. He stars in the upcoming The Only Living Pickpocket in New York , written and directed by Noah Segan. His defining collaborations with Spike Lee ( Do the Right Thing , Jungle Fever ) and the Coen brothers ( Barton Fink , which won him Best Actor at Cannes, Miller’s Crossing , The Big Lebowski ) established him as one of the most versatile actors of his generation. His acclaimed television work includes The Night Of and Severance, for which he received Emmy nominations, alongside blockbusters and other landmark films including O Brother, Where Art Thou? , Quiz Show , The Truce and Mia Madre . Turturro has also directed his own features, including Romance & Cigarettes , Mac (Caméra d’Or), and Fading Gigolo .

As Amanda and Martin are forced to make increasingly difficult choices, the repercussions spiral out of their control.

movies.title: Rammstein - Live in Mexico City
movies.description:
Filmed across three sold-out nights at the 65,000-capacity Foro Sol, RAMMSTEIN – LIVE IN MEXICO CITY captures one of the defining performances of the band's monumental five-year world stadium tour in a spectacular concert film directed by two-time Primetime Emmy® Award winner Paul Dugdale.
Spanning 135 concerts and witnessed by 6 million fans around the world, the tour marked a major chapter in Rammstein's career. Two-time GRAMMY® nominees with audiences across the globe, Rammstein have brought German-language rock to major venues around the world – combining colossal sound and live production on a scale entirely their own.
Featuring 20 career-spanning songs, the film places audiences at the heart of a show where 20-meter-high flames and towering industrial architecture are matched by moments of genuine connection between the band and the crowd.
From November 4, 2026, audiences worldwide can experience RAMMSTEIN – LIVE IN MEXICO CITY in cinematic 4K.

movies.description: Young Ruby leaves her small-town life in Tennessee for the beaches of Panama City, Florida, where she searches for a new beginning and encounters the pleasures and pitfalls of her adopted paradise. Ashley Judd gives a quietly magnetic performance in her first starring role, capturing Ruby’s uncertainty, independence, and determination to build a life on her own terms. movies.title: Run, Tecato Run
movies.description: Run, Tecato, Run is the last of three low-budget social problem films by Efraín Gutiérrez—all restored by the UCLA Film & Television Archive. Gutiérrez—the first Chicano feature director—not only starred in these films, but developed a grass-roots distribution strategy that allowed him to outperform Hollywood releases in several cities. Based on true incidents, Run, Tecato, Run depicts a junkie's efforts to get off heroin in order to reclaim and raise his daughter. Produced for $60,000, the film explores the connections between the Vietnam War, drug addiction, and crime—juxtaposing these against Mexican American family, culture and spirituality.

movies.title: Screamplay
movies.description:
Edgar Allan (Rufus B. Seder) is an aspiring screenwriter who has just come to Hollywood to make it in the movies... only to wind up working as the janitor at a fleabag apartment complex run by the greasy ex-boxer Martin (George Kuchar) instead. When Edgar begins channeling his frustrations with his kooky neighbors into fodder for his latest screenplay, the vivid murder scenes he writes begin to happen for real. As the bodies begin to pile up and the line between reality and fiction become increasingly blurred, Edgar, who is convinced that the only way to be a real writer is to suffer, is slowly driven mad.Inventively produced using a host of early cinematic techniques and featuring a memorable performance by underground film legend George Kuchar, Rufus Butler Seder's Screamplay is a singularly charming tribute to Old Hollywood and a marvel of low-budget but high-concept filmmaking.

movies.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
movies.description:
It is difficult to imagine precisely what cinema would be without its most influential and memorable titles. THE CABINET OF DR. CALIGARI in particular stands out as one such notable title in the international canon that in its time and forever thereafter has been heralded as a masterpiece of its craft, the singular model for expressionist, black-and-white filmmaking.
A landmark of horror filmmaking, its visual style is often copied or paid homage, and its remarkable twist ending has become all but a modern trope. Its long, haunting shadows and canted, dreamlike production design stay with viewers weeks, months, and years following an initial viewing.
The film is credited for introducing the "twist" ending and inspired EDWARD SCISSORHANDS by Tim Burton, THE IMAGINARIUM OF DR. PARNASSUS by Terry Gilliam, and Martin Scorsese's SHUTTER ISLAND, all of which share many striking similarities to CALIGARI.
"The first thing everyone notices and best remembers about THE CABINET OF DR. CALIGARI (1920) is the film's bizarre look. The actors inhabit a jagged landscape of sharp angles and tilted walls and windows, staircases climbing crazy diagonals, trees with spiky leaves, grass that looks like knives. These radical distortions immediately set the film apart from all earlier ones." – Roger Ebert, Chicago Sun-Times

A young college student is sent to the town of Whitewood to learn more about its history of witchcraft, unaware that the townsfolk are all under the spell of a powerful witch with dark plans for all who wander into her web of darkness. Covered in dense fog, streaked with deep shadows, and starring the legendary Christopher Lee (THE WICKER MAN) in a classically sinister performance, THE CITY OF THE DEAD conjures up an evocative and essential entry in the canon of witchcraft cinema. movies.title: The Craft
movies.cast: Robin Tunney, Fairuza Balk, Neve Campbell, Rachel True, Skeet Ulrich, Helen Shaver
movies.description:
Who doesn't love a good high school movie cliche? You know, tropes like the mean popular girl, the incredibly winsome new kid, the snarky outsiders, the handsome jock who always turns out to be a d-bag. Well, THE CRAFT takes all of those vital elements and throws in some black magic to create a thoroughly entertaining Gen-X witch's brew.
This film is about as insane as '90s Hollywood could get. New girl in school, Sarah (Robin Tunney), becomes instantly cooler when you realize she's a natural witch, while the goth girl, Nancy (Fairuza Balk, who should've spurned a whole new Oscar category for Best Crazy Eyes) becomes tremendously freakier when you realize that she can kill you on a whim.

movies.description: The complexities of race, class, and sexuality collide within a Memphis community in the strikingly raw debut feature from director Ira Sachs. With neorealist immediacy, The Delta tells what at first appears to be a simple love story: two young men—Lincoln (Shayne Gray), a closeted white teenager, and Minh (Thang Chan), a Black Vietnamese immigrant—meet at a cruising spot and embark on a nighttime journey by boat down the Mississippi River. movies.title: The Dreamed Adventure
movies.description: In her quietly thrilling, innovatively structured new film, German director Valeska Grisebach tells a story of immigrant lives on the fragile boundaries of Eastern and Western Europe that gradually shifts into a wide-ranging crime saga. Set in the Bulgarian border town of Svilengrad, The Dreamed Adventure initially follows Said (Syuleyman Letifov), a local worker reacclimating to the community after time away; yet soon Said disappears and the perspective shifts to that of his old flame Veska (Yana Radeva), an archaeologist who has also come back to town—and who grows worried that Said has fallen in with violent local gangsters. Taking it upon herself to track down Said, Veska intrepidly confronts a lawless, patriarchal network, which Grisebach depicts with remarkable authenticity and keen insight. As in her absorbing previous feature, Western (NYFF55), the director uses a vérité approach to engage with tried-and-true movie genres, subtly recontextualizing the contours of cinematic grammar. Winner of the Jury Prize at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival. A Janus Films release.

From Paris to New York, Alain charts Dimitri’s travels and emotional journey as the images around him slip away. Together they wander the streets with their cameras, encountering friends and strangers along their path and revealing unseen beauty and connections in the world. As Dimitri’s vision fades, he invites Alain along to see a new perspective and shift his gaze toward the hidden face of the Earth. This intimate documentary brings Dimitri’s innermost feelings to the surface in an affecting portrait of an artist in transit, in his work and every sense of his life.

Harry is an old-school hustler. A classic native New Yorker, he moves through life lubricating palms with cash, relying on his wits and connections. But times are changing for Harry. His daily pickpocket take isn’t green bills and wristwatches, it’s credit cards and cell phones. And one unfortunate night, cryptocurrency and a handgun.

THE ONLY LIVING PICKPOCKET IN NEW YORK is a nostalgic portrait of a small-time career criminal navigating today's digitally networked world. Writer/Director Noah Segan's modern metropolis is powered by the ephemera of a time gone by, with shoe-leather action brought to radiant life by a terrific cast, led by John Turturro's exceptional turn as Harry.

movies.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
movies.description: Originally produced for the London stage in 1973, THE ROCKY HORROR SHOW was Richard O'Brien's musical tribute to B-movies, sci-fi, ‘50s rock, and Hammer Horror, as filtered through the transgressive and camp attitudes of rock-opera and punk. A huge success, the play caught the attention of 20th Century Fox, who fast-tracked a low-budget theatrical adaptation. Featuring most of the creative team and cast of the original production – including Tim Curry reviving his much-acclaimed performance – THE ROCKY HORROR PICTURE SHOW was a flop when originally released in September 1975. Now one of the most beloved and enduring camp classics of all time, ROCKY HORROR is still shown in theaters across the country and has become a cultural phenomenon that is a unique and unforgettable experience for all patrons. Patrons are encouraged to engage with the film and performance by coming to the show dressed up. Come be a part of the longest-running midnight movie phenomenon in history!

This time, Sorkin puts whistleblower Frances Haugen (Mikey Madison, ANORA) and Wall Street Journal reporter Jeff Horwitz (Jeremy Allen White, The Bear) at the center of a David-and-Goliath story that threatens to expose the social network’s most guarded secrets. And yes, Jeremy Strong (Succession) is stepping into the Zuckerberg hoodie. Expect rapid-fire dialogue, institutional takedowns, and maybe even some walking and talking. Consider this your latest notification from the algorithm: see this in theaters.

movies.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
movies.description: 50 years ago, five youths on a weekend getaway in the Texas countryside fell prey to a butcher in a mask made of human skin and his cannibalistic family, and horror cinema would never be the same. Violent, confrontational, and shockingly realistic, director Tobe Hooper’s The Texas Chain Saw Massacre terrified audiences in a way never thought possible when it was unleashed on a politically and socially tumultuous America in 1974. Facing a storm of controversy, censorship, and outcry throughout its troubled release, this masterpiece of horror has stood the test of time to become a landmark motion picture and cultural milestone.

movies.description: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (Malkovich) and Lee (Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). As the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies amongst the island’s iconic statues, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways. Martin McDonagh ( In Bruges , The Banshees of Inisherin ) returns with another masterful character study, a richly funny political thriller replete with the writer/director’s trademark wit, voice, and poignancy.

movies.title: Wilmington 10 – U.S.A. 10,000
movies.description: Gerima’s first documentary examines the case of nine Black men and one white woman who were wrongfully convicted and imprisoned following racial violence in Wilmington, North Carolina in 1971. Rather than presenting a conventional account of the case, Gerima builds a vivid chorus of testimony from the defendants, their families, Wilmington residents, and political activists, connecting their struggle to the 1898 Wilmington massacre, the unfinished history of the Civil Rights Movement, and liberation movements around the world. A landmark of Black independent cinema, Wilmington 10 – U.S.A. 10,000 remains a vital document of collective memory, resistance, and the ongoing struggle to make suppressed histories visible.

movies.title: You Can See Everything
movies.description: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder ( The Rehearsal ) and Lance Oppenheim ( Primetime ) comes You Can See Everything .

movies.title: Yuri!!! on Ice (Subtitled)
movies.description:
Presented in Japanese with English subtitles
Big dreams, a shared passion – on the ice, they call it love. After suffering a humiliating loss at the Grand Prix Final, Japan’s number one skater, Yuri Katsuki, is ready to hang up his skates for good. But when his idol and five-time champion Victor Nikiforov offers to be his coach, Yuri’s put on a trek for gold and to discover the true meaning of victory! Together, they’ll face skaters from around the world.

movies.title: 12 Years A Slave
movies.description: 12 Years a Slave is based on an incredible true story of one man’s fight for survival and freedom. In the pre-Civil War United States, Solomon Northup (Chiwetel Ejiofor), a free Black man from upstate New York, is abducted and sold into slavery. Facing cruelty personified by a malevolent slave owner (Michael Fassbender) as well as unexpected kindnesses, Solomon struggles not only to stay alive, but to retain his dignity. In the twelfth year of his unforgettable odyssey, Solomon's chance meeting with a Canadian abolitionist (Brad Pitt) forever alters his life. The winner of three Academy Awards including Best Picture, 12 Years a Slave returns to BAM screens alongside the new restoration of Gordon Park’s version of the same story, Solomon Northrup’s Odyssey .

movies.title: 2026 Oscar Nominated Animated Shorts
movies.description: These meticulously animated works of art follow a wide range of fascinating characters, from an Olympic swimmer who survived the Holocaust to an intrepid kid bravely attempting to rescue her village. Please note that some films contain disturbing material and may not be suitable for very young children. Butterfly Dir. Florence Miailhe France, 15min A poignant retelling of Olympic swimmer Alfred Nakache’s life, from his rise to fame to surviving Auschwitz, presented as memories flashing back during his final swim. Forevergreen Dirs. Nathan Engelhardt & Jeremy Spears US, 13min A joyful adventure featuring an orphaned bear cub and a fatherly tree turns serious when the cub is tempted by the allure of easy food. Fire and deadly danger ensue as the cub is left bereft of hope and on the verge of a ruinous end, until the sacrificial love of the tree falls into place. The Girl Who Cried Pearls Dirs. Chris Lavis & Maciek Szczerbowski Canada, 17min A haunting fable about a girl overwhelmed by sorrow, the boy who loves her, and how greed leads good hearts to wicked deeds. Retirement Plan Dir. John Kelly Ireland, 7min Ray (voiced by Domhall Gleeson) fantasizes about everything he’d love to do in retirement, once he finally has the “time.” The Three Sisters Dir. Konstantin Bronzit Israel & Cyprus, 14min Three sisters live a lonely life on an isolated island, each in their own small house. One day, circumstances change, and they are forced to rent out one of the houses. Also screening in this program: Éiru Dir. Giovanna Ferrari Ireland, 13min When the water mysteriously disappears from the well in a warrior clan’s village, an intrepid child descends into the belly of the earth to retrieve it. Éiru is the story of a kid in search of a challenge and a goddess in search of a champion.

movies.title: 2026 Oscar Nominated Live-Action Shorts
movies.description: These Oscar-contending films from Israel, the UK, the US, and France explore the messy, beautiful, and often forbidden ways we seek connection. Butcher’s Stain Dir. Meyer Levinson-Blount Israel, 26min Samir, a Palestinian butcher working at an Israeli supermarket, is accused of tearing down the Israeli hostage posters in the break room. Samir sets out to prove his innocence in order to keep the job he so desperately needs. A Friend of Dorothy Dir. Lee Knight UK, 21min Dorothy is a lonely widow whose body is failing but whose mind remains sharp as ever. When 17-year-old JJ accidentally kicks his football into her garden, an unlikely friendship blossoms. Jane Austen’s Period Drama Dirs. Steve Pinder & Julia Aks US, 12min In 1813 England, Essy Talbot’s long-awaited marriage proposal takes a messy turn when her period arrives at a very bad time. The Singers Dir. Sam A. Davis US, 18min The Singers is a film adaptation of a 19th-century short story written by Ivan Turgenev, in which downtrodden patrons in a lowly pub connect unexpectedly through an impromptu sing-off. Two People Exchanging Saliva Dirs. Natalie Musteata & Alexandre Singh France, 36min In a society where kissing is punishable by death and people pay for things by receiving slaps to the face, an unhappy woman shops compulsively in a department store and becomes entranced by one of the employees.

A sort-of sequel to Wong’s Days of Being Wild and In the Mood for Love, the ’60s-set 2046 revisits Tony Leung Chiu-wai’s Chow, now a suave science-fiction writer, to chronicle his various affairs with women (including Faye Wong, Zhang Ziyi, and Gong…

Written, directed, and produced by Wong Kar-wai, 2046 picks up loose ends from two previous Wong features, Days of Being Wild (1990) and In the Mood for Love (2000), with Tony Leung and Maggie Cheung reprising their respective roles as writer Chow Mo-wan and his lost soulmate, Su Li-zhen. Named for the apartment in which Chow and Su connected, 2046 weaves together four disparate narratives about the romantic affairs Chow pursues while writing science fiction (with beautifully realized scenes pulled from his pulp sci-fi novels), gambling, and trying to move on. “A puzzle, a valentine, a sacred hymn to beauty… and a cynical shrug of the shoulders at the damned impermanence of it all, 2046 is a movie to live in,” Glenn Kenny declared in Premiere .

movies.title: 25Th Hour
movies.description: Academy Award nominee Edward Norton ( American History X ) heads an amazing all-star cast in this critically acclaimed film by Spike Lee ( Do the Right Thing , Summer of Sam ) recognized for its compassionate view of post-9/11 New York City. In 24 short hours, Monty Brogan (Norton) goes to prison for seven long years. Once a king of Manhattan, Monty is about to say goodbye to the life he knew—a life that opened doors to New York's swankiest clubs but also alienated him from the people closest to him. In his last day on the outside, Monty tries to reconnect with his father (Brian Cox), and gets together with two old friends, Jacob (Philip Seymour Hoffman) and Slaughtery (Barry Pepper). And then there's his girlfriend, Naturelle (Rosario Dawson), who might (or might not) have been the one who tipped off the cops. Monty's not sure of much these days, but with time running out, there are choices to be made as he struggles to redeem himself in the 25th hour.

movies.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
movies.description: The nature of the infected is changing… Director Nia DaCosta expands the grisly, post-apocalyptic world first forged by Danny Boyle and Alex Garland with 2002’s 28 Days Later and built upon in 2025’s 28 Years Later . In this third entry, Dr. Kelson (Fiennes) forms a relationship whose consequences could alter the fate of humanity, while Spike’s (Williams) encounter with Jimmy Crystal (O’Connell) spirals into a nightmare he can’t escape. In the world of The Bone Temple, the infected are no longer the greatest threat to survival—the inhumanity of the survivors proves far more terrifying.

movies.title: 64Th New York Film Festival
movies.description: Presented by Film at Lincoln Center in partnership with Rolex, the 64th New York Film Festival takes place September 25 through October 12 at Lincoln Center and in venues across the city, including BAM. The lineup currently includes new films from James Gray, Tony Gilroy, Ava DuVernay, Sompot Chidgasornpongse, Ryûsuke Hamaguchi, Pedro Almodóvar, Chris Rock, Werner Herzog, Jesse Eisenberg, Jonathan Glazer, and others. Join us for exceptional new works from around the world, featuring conversations with filmmakers, industry leaders, and more. Passes and individual tickets are on sale now. Note: These are Special Screenings , meaning only Tier 2 members and above can receive their $5 off discount

movies.title: 9 To 5
movies.description: Three working women try to overthrow their misogynist, egotistical boss in this wacky, over-the-top 1980 comedy. Directed by Colin Higgins (writer of Harold and Maude ), and perhaps best-known for its titular theme song, the workplace romp spawned a television series, stage adaptation, and further launched Dolly Parton to mainstream superstardom.

movies.title: 9 to 5
movies.description:
In 9 TO 5, a group of female office workers – the all-knowing manager who trained the boss but can't get promoted (Lily Tomlin), a befuddled newcomer (Jane Fonda), and an alluring personal secretary everyone presumes is having an affair (Dolly Parton) – all band together to seek revenge on the man who is making their lives miserable. Directed by Colin Higgins and produced by Bruce Gilbert from a screenplay by Higgins and Patricia Resnick, 9 TO 5 received an Academy Award® nomination for the hit title song written and performed by Dolly Parton. 
Disney will donate net proceeds* from each U.S. ticket purchase to The Dollywood Foundation to support its flagship program, Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library. 
*Net proceeds refers to the amount received by Disney from the U.S. theatrical ticket sale for the film during the period October 9-15, 2026, less (a) amounts retained by exhibitors, (b) third-party distribution fees and expenses, (c) third-party marketing and advertising expenses incurred in connection with the campaign, and (d) CAF America's administrative fees. 
Learn more at cafamerica.org and dollywoodfoundation.org.

movies.title: 99%: The Occupy Wall Street Collaborative Film
movies.director: Aaron Aites, Audrey Ewell & Nina Krstic
movies.description: Lou Reed narrates this award-winning documentary, a deep dive into the breadth and depth of the Occupy Wall Street Movement. The spark lit in a small park in lower Manhattan would snowball into an international movement, aimed at removing money from politics in an effort to move power from corporate interests into the hands of the people. The thought-provoking presentation includes interviews from Occupiers, economist Jeffrey Sachs, and business magnate Russell Simmons, tracing the movement’s aims of tackling affordable access to health care and education, protecting the environment, creating jobs, and more.

movies.title: A Bittersweet Life
movies.description: A mob enforcer (Lee Byung-hun, No Other Choice) with a sterling record of loyal service finds himself fighting for his life after sparing the life of his boss’s straying mistress (Shin Min-a) in Kim’s drum-tight neo-noir thriller, unusually grounded…

movies.description: A sprawling and intimate evocation of the Taiwan of Yang’s teenage years: the outset of the 1960s, a period defined by street gang activity, the political repression of the Kuomintang military government, and the ubiquity of American pop culture. A…

movies.title: A Flame At The Pier
movies.description: 35mm print imported from Japan (courtesy of the Japan Foundation) “An early masterpiece by Shinoda, this bleak youth film follows Sabu (Takashi Fujiki), who exploits fellow dockworkers under orders from his boss. He falls for Yuki (Mariko Kaga, making her feature film debut), but their bittersweet romance spirals into conflict. Set against the sharply photographed docklands of Yokohama, the film marks the fourth collaboration between Shinoda and Shuji Terayama. Together, they deftly weave themes of working class struggles and labor strikes into the story, making a critique of postwar reality of Japan. Terayama also contributed two theme songs, performed by the lead Takashi Fujiki.” - Akinaru Rokkaku
